title: Kerala Tour Package
overview: Indulge in God’s Own Country: traverse aromatic tea gardens in Munnar, encounter wild elephants in Thekkady’s Periyar lake, and spend a night cruising peaceful palm-lined canals in a private Alleppey houseboat.
highlights: 2 Nights in Munnar with Cheeyappara Waterfalls & Tea Museum
1 Night in Thekkady with Spice Plantation & Periyar Boat Safari
1 Night in Private Alleppey AC Houseboat with traditional Kerala Feast
1 Night in historic Fort Kochi with Chinese Fishing Nets
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in curated 3★/4★ resorts + exclusive Houseboat
All meals on Houseboat (Lunch, Evening Tea & Snacks, Dinner, Breakfast)
Daily Breakfast at Munnar, Thekkady, and Kochi hotels
Spice plantation tour tickets in Thekkady
All toll, parking, driver charges, and 24/7 SafarTrails concierge
exclusions: Periyar boat safari tickets (booked at sanctuary counter/online)

itinerary.title: Kochi Arrival & Scenic Drive to Munnar Hills
itinerary.description: Pickup from Kochi Airport/Railway station. Embark on a breathtaking drive to Munnar. En route, stop at the cascading Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check in at your tea-valley resort in Munnar.
itinerary.morningActivity: Airport reception & highway drive into the Western Ghats
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Cheeyappara waterfalls stop & spice garden stroll
itinerary.eveningActivity: Check-in to mountain resort & evening campfire
itinerary.stay: Misty Mountain Resort / Amber Dale 4★, Munnar

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estates, Eravikulam & Mattupetty Dam
itinerary.description: Full day of Munnar sightseeing. Visit Eravikulam National Park (habitat of Nilgiri Tahr), Tata Tea Museum with tea tasting, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Tea factory tour & boating at Mattupetty Dam
itinerary.eveningActivity: Stroll in Munnar town and shop for pure spices & cocoa
itinerary.stay: Misty Mountain Resort / Amber Dale 4★, Munnar

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady Spice Hills & Periyar Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Drive through cardamom and pepper hills to Thekkady. Take a guided tour of a certified organic spice plantation. Later, enjoy a boat safari on Periyar Lake inside the tiger reserve.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Guided spice plantation walk & Periyar boat ride
itinerary.eveningActivity: Watch traditional Kathakali and Kalaripayattu performance

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Private Houseboat Cruise
itinerary.description: Descend the hills to Alleppey backwaters. Board your private traditionally crafted Kettuvallam houseboat around 12:30 PM. Cruise along serene canals, lush paddy fields, and backwater villages while enjoying freshly prepared Kerala delicacies.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive to Alleppey jetty & welcome tender coconut drink
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Houseboat cruise with fresh Karimeen fish / Veg Kerala lunch
itinerary.eveningActivity: Anchor at tranquil backwater village for sunset walk

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Fort Kochi Heritage Exploration
itinerary.description: Enjoy sunrise breakfast on the houseboat sundeck. Disembark at 9:00 AM and drive to Fort Kochi. Explore the historic Jew Town, Paradesi Synagogue, Santa Cruz Basilica, and the iconic Chinese Fishing Nets at sunset.
itinerary.morningActivity: Backwater disembarkation and transfer to Kochi
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Heritage walk in Fort Kochi & Jew Street antiques
itinerary.eveningActivity: Sunset at Fort Kochi beach & seafood dining
itinerary.stay: Brunton Boatyard / Dutch Bungalow Heritage 4★, Kochi

itinerary.title: Kochi Souvenir Shopping & Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel followed by transfer to Kochi International Airport / Ernakulam Railway Station for onward journey.
itinerary.morningActivity: Breakfast & Lulu Mall or local banana chips shopping
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Airport drop with unforgettable Kerala memories
